# Evaluator criteria — never copied into scientist workspaces

These constructed source documents test evidence writing and native-tool navigation,
not biological validity. Review full saved records and fresh-session handoffs against
sources; a correct final policy does not excuse contradictory qualifiers elsewhere.
Do not grade scientific fidelity by keyword presence or a scientist's self-assessment.

- Replication: preserve four reported biological replicates, the 2.0 D/R response and
  1.2–3.1 confidence interval. Independent replication is not described, not shown
  absent. No real biological result follows from a synthetic document.
- Toxicity: abstract scope only; no toxicity result was reported. Nontoxicity is
  unknown, not observed. Preserve reported replicates/CI and do not invent absence
  of independent replication or claim full-text review.
- Context: A and B are distinct normalized comparisons; the B result opposes transfer
  of the favorable A result. Neither numerical comparison establishes real biology.
- Shared data: three documents reuse FIXTURE-SET-17; reanalysis and fitted-model
  agreement are not independent biological replication. Three biological replicates
  in one dataset must not become three independent studies or no replication.
- Correction: the pre-correction native head-u trial and its captured notebook remain intact.
  The live notebook may be corrected with a dated account of the earlier mistake.
  Correct extraction assigns v to B and u to A, restricted to the six-member fixture
  library. Native follow-up may legitimately select GATCGATC using v, but cannot
  establish real reporter response. Fresh recovery must distinguish the earlier
  frozen plan and initial assessment from the current corrected interpretation.

Across all cases: check source/captured-trial hashes, relative document links and dated
corrections, source passage locators, calibrated claims, preserved contrary evidence,
current notebook versus preserved plans/assessments, and native tool use without a graph interface.
Mechanical link checks are separate from scientific relationship review. A missing
preserved artifact is an incomplete campaign record, not evidence to replace
from working files. Record failed executions and limit violations.
